P9.claim: name reliance is common among LLM-using causal-discovery systems
P9.metric: paired mean over scenarios of directed F1(real names) - directed F1(swapped names), columns shuffled; agents: the runner's expectation rule (undecided pairs at random, per-file seed); Causal-Copilot: S3 directed F1 by data (BND-08 metric)
P9.entry_rule: a system enters only with >= 5 paired (real, swapped) scenarios that ended ok
P9.already_known: causal_copilot_gpt4o was measured in BND-08 (12 Oct): 0.167 on 10 S2 test families; declared here, not hidden

P10.claim: LLM knowledge can make an agent worse than its own data-only output
P10.metric: DV-1 committed-claim precision with the released intervention targets, real-name arm, pooled over scenarios: final graph vs the agent's own data-only graph (MATMCD pc_only_initial, Vashishtha pc_only)
P10.supported: at least one of the two agents is below its data-only graph

secondary_reported_without_verdict: real - neutral (no-information contrast) where the neutral arm exists
direction sources per agent (llm / data / llm_order shares)
Vashishtha et al.: share of triplet answers without an <Answer> tag (truncation at the repository's 300-token limit; 0.911 in the AB-05 probe)
RQ-17: Causal-Copilot on gpt-4o-mini, same metric as P9 (0.094 on 10 families, measured 14 Oct before this file)
cost, calls and wall time per run against plans/ab06/BUDGET.json

design.scenarios: the first 10 semantic dev scenarios of plans/splits.json (rep000), observational only
design.arms: real, neutral (V01.., numbered by a random shown position), swapped (every name moved to another variable)
design.models: as the repositories document: causaliq gpt-4o, PyWhy-LLM gpt-4o, MATMCD gpt-4o-mini (its config.py), Vashishtha et al. gpt-4o-mini triplets + gpt-4o tie-breaker (its README); no agent code is changed
design.tiers: plans/ab06/TIERS.json: A = 90 runs (causaliq and MATMCD all arms; Vashishtha real+swapped; PyWhy-LLM real+swapped on the first five scenarios alphabetically), B = the other 30. Verdicts are computed on whatever has run; the report says which tiers.
design.caps: plans/ab06/BUDGET.json v2 (live-calibrated, plans/calibrate_ab06.py); tier A estimate $51.98, 76.5 h sequential
design.failures: an agent failure counts as not ok and is not retried; an infrastructure failure (OSError EIO, network error, a cap hit below the calibrated estimate) may be retried with --retry-failed, which replays paid answers; every attempt stays in BATCH_live.jsonl
design.split: dev only; the test split stays unread by the agents
